definition: The combined effect of working together that is greater than individual efforts
example: The merger created synergy between the two companies.

definition: Able to grow or expand efficiently without losing quality or increasing costs proportionally
example: Our cloud-based solution is highly scalable.

definition: A standard or point of reference used to measure performance or quality
example: We use industry benchmarks to evaluate our progress.

definition: To hire an external company to handle business tasks or services
example: Many firms outsource their customer support operations.

definition: The act of buying or taking control of another company or asset
example: The acquisition strengthened our market position.

definition: The total income generated from business operations before expenses are deducted
example: Quarterly revenue exceeded expectations by 15 percent.

definition: To discuss terms and reach an agreement through compromise and communication
example: We need to negotiate better terms with our suppliers.

definition: A specific date or time by which a task or project must be completed
example: The project deadline is set for next Friday.
